import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]/v + params[2]*np.sin(x) + params[3]*np.cos(x) + params[4]*x*v
            + params[5]*x**4 + params[6]*x**2*v**2 + params[7]*x**3 + params[8]*x**2 + params[9]*v)
